notes: Public production URL: https://centra-two.vercel.app (Vercel auto-suffixed to 'centra-two' because centra.vercel.app is owned by another account). Project 'centra' under Webzite Studio team. Deploy required NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca so Node trusts the machine's proxy/AV root CA — this was the only blocker (connectivity + auth were fine). Team-suffixed and preview URLs stay behind Vercel Deployment Protection (401); the clean production alias is public, same as giovanni-serrano.vercel.app.
